query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(gotReply) as replies,
  ROUND(SUM(gotReply)/COUNT(*)*100,1) as reply_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN replySentiment='positive' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as positive,
  SUM(CASE WHEN replySentiment='negative' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as negative,
  SUM(stageAdvanced) as stage_advanced,
  SUM(converted) as converted,
  SUM(dncTriggered) as dnc
FROM message_outcomes WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH);
